name: Ethereum
description: A decentralized, open-source blockchain platform with smart contract functionality.
blocks: Ethereum is a decentralized, open-source blockchain system that features smart contract functionality. It was proposed in 2013 by **Vitalik Buterin** and went live on **July 30, 2015**.

- **Consensus:** Proof of Stake (since The Merge, Sept 2022)
- **Block time:** ~12 seconds
- **Smart contract languages:** Solidity, Vyper

name: Geo
description: A decentralized knowledge graph protocol enabling collaborative, permissionless knowledge curation.
blocks: Geo is a decentralized protocol for structuring and sharing knowledge on the internet. It combines a **knowledge graph** data model with **blockchain-based** governance.
The protocol allows anyone to create, edit, and organize information as interconnected entities — each with typed properties, relations, and rich content blocks.
